description: A short low bass riff on the Dirty Reese bass sound, played by hand on the keys.
Hold one key and the built-in step sequencer plays an acid line with this sound.
A simple melody on the Scream Lead sound, which uses oscillator sync.
Hold a chord and the built-in arpeggiator plays it with the Siren sound.
A rolling drum and bass style bass line on the Neuro Rolling sound.
Pulsing sub bass that steps between three low notes.
